a: TypeScript adds static types on top of JavaScript.
interface describes the shape of an object.
prop?: string means the property may be undefined.
string | number means the value can be either type.
any disables checking; prefer unknown for safer unknowns.
Enums name a set of related constants.
as const narrows to literal types.
Partial<T> makes all properties of T optional.
never means a value that should not occur.
